prompt: File a wilderness location into wiki/templates/place.md. Public canon establishes a lake two days north, a mangrove wall one day east, no established southern neighbor, and an old road three days west. Labeled filing fixture — do not invent the southern neighbor as canon. (Cardinal Where pattern also applies when improving wiki/entities/place/high-eyrie.md or wiki/entities/place/river-slack-basin.md.)
expected_output: The filed location uses the place template and its Where section includes natural-language north, east, south, and west entries with wikilinked neighbors where known, approximate days of travel, and an explicit canon gap for the south.

assertions.text: Where section has explicit **North:** / **East:** / **South:** / **West:** entries each with ~N days of travel language (or equivalent travel-day distances)
Only the three known neighbors (lake north, mangrove wall east, old road west) are wikilinked with approximate travel-day distances; south has neither a wikilink nor a proper name
Marks the missing southern direction with explicit canon-gap wording (not inventing a named southern place as fact)
Output follows wiki/templates/place.md Where conventions: explicit cardinal lines with travel-day distances AND an explicit canon gap for any missing direction — a bare ## Where heading alone fails
